en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Season 2 Begins

entries.headline: Suisei Bloom announced as a survival conversation adventure set in a stranded space resort
entries.summary: Solo developer MITOH opened the Steam page for Suisei Bloom. Players control the amnesiac Mint, manage hunger and oxygen in a disabled space resort, wait for rescue, and uncover her past. A free PC release is planned, with no date announced.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_report label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 11:31。

entries.headline: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds starts Season 2 with a new one-on-one Duel Mode
entries.summary: Sega has started Season 2 of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds, adding the one-on-one Duel Mode and detailing collaborations including Godzilla, Evangelion, and Final Fantasy VII Remake. Digital pricing and Season Pass 2 offerings were also updated.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_relay_official label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 13:56。

entries.headline: ARC Raiders hits a seven-month Steam player peak after its 2.0 update
entries.summary: IGN reports that ARC Raiders reached 166,670 concurrent Steam players, its highest level in seven months, after the Frozen Trail 2.0 update, Pendola Pass map, Grappling Hook, and an October 8–12 free weekend. The update is available on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_report label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 11 日 05:07。

entries.headline: Vaultbreakers launches a free demo ahead of an October 16 PvPvE alpha test
entries.summary: BetaDwarf has released a free Vaultbreakers demo on Steam. The extraction action RPG supports solo play or groups of up to three, includes Japanese text, and is scheduled to begin a PvPvE alpha test on October 16.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_relay_official label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 10:36。

entries.headline: Coloratis announced as a three-part color puzzle collection for Steam
entries.summary: Developer Leo has opened the Steam page for Coloratis, a collection of three puzzle formats built around color and different styles of reasoning. It is planned for PC release during 2026.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_relay_official label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 16:03。

entries.headline: Sega reveals a Brazil map for Crazy Taxi: World Tour at BGS 2026
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that Sega announced a new Brazil map for Crazy Taxi: World Tour during the opening program of Brasil Game Show 2026.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_report label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 11:02。

entries.headline: Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator releases a free demo ahead of its November 19 launch
entries.summary: Animalsoft has released a free Steam demo for Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator. The game combines aquarium management, incremental progression, and third-person exploration; its PC launch is set for November 19, 2026, with Steam Next Fest participation from October 19–26.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_relay_official label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 13:49。

entries.summary: DreadXP and MANGLEDmaw Games have announced a live-action Amanda the Adventurer film, with members of the original game team involved. The report also names John Ainslie as the screenwriter.

entries.headline: Rumor: Starfield's Switch 2 port may have been shelved
entries.summary: Game Rant relays an insider claim that Bethesda may have shelved or canceled a Switch 2 version of Starfield. The report is based on a single unconfirmed source and awaits official confirmation.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the unconfirmed label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 11 日 06:30; the rumor itself remains unconfirmed.

entries.headline: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen review awards an 8/10 and cites more than 20 hours of content
entries.summary: 3DM relays GameSpot's 8/10 review of Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, which says the expansion offers more than 20 hours of content. It praises the new map, exploration, and combat while noting repetition and spell-system issues.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_report label.
entries.timeNote: Published at Beijing time 10 月 10 日 22:31。

entries.headline: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen launches as Steam concurrency rises to 32,132
entries.summary: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen launched on October 9. AUTOMATON reports that Steam concurrency rose to 32,132, roughly ten times the prior level, alongside the expansion's new region, enemies, and equipment.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_report label.

entries.headline: WARDOGS Season 2 substantially reworks Lonestar's skills and combat role
entries.summary: WARDOGS Season 2 introduces a major rebalance for Lonestar, changing skills, damage values, and the character's combat role. AUTOMATON relays the official update details.

entries.headline: High-speed action game KICK sets a November 3 Steam release
entries.summary: KICK is scheduled to launch for PC via Steam on November 3, 2026. The high-speed action game is built around kick-based movement and combat.
entries.verification: Pinned source text was reviewed; subject, timing, and core facts support the media_relay_official label.

entries.headline: Nivalis Nights lead writer says its comfortable life must be earned
entries.summary: Lead writer Thomas Welsh tells PC Gamer that Nivalis Nights is intentionally stressful rather than a purely cozy life sim. Players will need to work and make choices to build a comfortable life in the city.
